Force fixed opening and closing times for the coop door. When enabled, the fixed time fully replaces the sunrise/sunset computation — light and door protocols shift accordingly.
Adjust the exact moment (in minutes) at which the door opens, closes and the light switches on, relative to sunrise and sunset. Useful for shifting a few minutes depending on the season.

Why these delays? Sunrise and sunset are calculated moments — at those exact times the light is still very low. The chickens go to roost slightly after sunset and come out slightly after sunrise. The three offsets below let you match reality: Door opening (after sunrise) — waits a few minutes so the chickens have real daylight when the door opens. Door closing (after sunset) — waits until every chicken is inside before the door closes, otherwise a straggler stays locked out for the night. Light on (before sunset) — lights up the interior in advance so the chickens can see their way in as dusk falls.

Note. When a fixed time is forced above, the two door offsets are ignored — the door opens or closes at the exact time you set. The light offset still applies, so the interior can light up before the forced closing time.
